info.name: NEXUS - AI KYC Service
info.description: AI-powered identity verification service. User-facing verification submission and status check; internal endpoints for compliance officers, audit retrieval, retry eligibility, SAR filing, and manual review. Port: 8091

formdata.description: Full legal name as on document (required)
Date of birth ISO format YYYY-MM-DD (required)
Language for AI responses: es | en (optional, default: es)

request.description:
Submit identity verification documents. AI processes the document and returns a decision.

Request (multipart/form-data):
- document (file, required): Document image
- fullName (text, required)
- dateOfBirth (text, required): YYYY-MM-DD
- documentNumber (text, required)
- documentType (text, required): INE | PASSPORT | DRIVER_LICENSE | NATIONAL_ID
- nationality (text, optional)
- language (text, optional, default: es)

Response 200: KycVerificationResult {
  verificationId: String (or null on error),
  status: PENDING | PROCESSING | APPROVED | REJECTED | REVIEW_REQUIRED,
  userFacingMessage: String,
  canRetry: boolean,
  retryDelayHours: int,
  requiresAction: boolean
}
Response 400: KycVerificationResult with error message for invalid documentType
Response 500: KycVerificationResult with generic error

Check the status of a KYC verification by verification ID.

Response 200: StatusResponse {
  verificationId: String,
  status: String,
  submittedAt: String (ISO-8601),
  decidedAt: String (empty if pending),
  userFacingMessage: String,
  canRetry: boolean,
  requiresManualReview: boolean
}
Response 404: Not Found

All verification attempts for a user, newest first. Compliance dashboard view.

Response 200: List<KycDocumentMongoDB>

Full PostgreSQL audit trail for one verification (all state transitions).

Response 200: List<KycAuditEntryJPA> [{ id, verificationId, action, performedBy, performedAt, details }]

Compliance officer submits manual review decision for a REVIEW_REQUIRED verification.

Request body (Map<String,String>):
- reviewOutcome: APPROVED | REJECTED (required)
- reviewNotes: String (optional)
- reviewedBy: String (required, operator ID)

Response 200: { verificationId, reviewOutcome, status, reviewedAt }
Response 404: Not Found

Daily KYC processing metrics for compliance dashboard.

Response 200: { totalVerifications: long, pendingProcessing: long, serviceStatus: 'OPERATIONAL', generatedAt }
